sanskrit_text: कर्मण्येवाधिकारस्ते मा फलेषु कदाचन। मा कर्मफलहेतुर्भूर्मा ते सङ्गोऽस्त्वकर्मणि॥
transliteration: karmaṇy-evādhikāras te mā phaleṣu kadācana, mā karma-phala-hetur bhūr mā te saṅgo 'stvakarmaṇi
english_translation: You have a right to perform your prescribed duty, but you are not entitled to the fruits of action. Never consider yourself the cause of the results of your activities, and never be attached to not doing your duty.
commentary_summary: Focus entirely on righteous execution and skill in action while relinquishing anxiety over the end outcome.

sanskrit_text: ध्यायतो विषयान्पुंसः सङ्गस्तेषूपजायते। सङ्गात्सञ्जायते कामः कामात्क्रोधोऽभिजायते॥
transliteration: dhyāyato viṣayān puṁsaḥ saṅgas teṣūpajāyate, saṅgāt sañjāyate kāmaḥ kāmāt krodho 'bhijāyate
english_translation: While contemplating the objects of the senses, a person develops attachment to them, and from such attachment lust develops, and from lust anger arises.
commentary_summary: Fixating on desired objects or outcomes creates obsession, clouded judgment, and reactive anger.

sanskrit_text: श्रेयान्स्वधर्मो विगुणः परधर्मात्स्वनुष्ठितात्। स्वधर्मे निधनं श्रेयः परधर्मो भयावहः॥
transliteration: śreyān sva-dharmo viguṇaḥ para-dharmāt sv-anuṣṭhitāt, sva-dharme nidhanaṁ śreyaḥ para-dharmo bhayāvahaḥ
english_translation: It is far better to discharge one's own prescribed duty, even if imperfectly, than to perform another's duty perfectly. Destruction in the course of performing one's own duty is better than engaging in another's, for to follow another's path is dangerous.
commentary_summary: Authenticity to one's own innate role and natural strengths outweighs imitating external expectations.

sanskrit_text: उद्धरेदात्मनात्मानं नात्मानमवसादयेत्। आत्मैव ह्यात्मनो बन्धुरात्मैव रिपुरात्मनः॥
transliteration: uddhared ātmanātmānaṁ nātmānam avasādayet, ātmaiva hy ātmano bandhur ātmaiva ripur ātmanaḥ
english_translation: One must elevate oneself through one's own mind, and not degrade oneself. For the mind is the best friend of the self, and also the greatest enemy.
commentary_summary: Internal discipline and mental self-mastery are the prerequisites for personal agency and overcoming despair.

sanskrit_text: आपदर्थे धनं रक्षेद्दारान् रक्षेद्धनैरपि। आत्मानं सततं रक्षेद्दारैरपि धनैरपि॥
transliteration: āpad-arthe dhanaṁ rakṣed dārān rakṣed dhanair api, ātmānaṁ satataṁ rakṣed dārair api dhanair api
english_translation: Save money for times of adversity. Guard your spouse even at the cost of your wealth. But continuously protect your own life, even at the cost of spouse and wealth.
commentary_summary: Strategic self-preservation and contingency reserve allocation are foundational to survival.

sanskrit_text: अनृतं साहसं माया मूर्खत्वमतिलोभिता। अशौचत्वं निर्दयत्वं स्त्रीणां दोषाः स्वभावजाः॥
english_translation: Before embarking on an action, always ask three questions: Why am I doing this? What might the results be? Will I be successful? Proceed only when finding convincing answers.
commentary_summary: Calculated foresight and rigorous consequence assessment precede commitment.

sanskrit_text: नात्यन्तं सरलेन भाव्यं गत्वा पश्य वनस्थलीम्। छिद्यन्ते सरलास्तत्र कुब्जास्तिष्ठन्ति पादपाः॥
transliteration: nātyantaṁ saralena bhāvyaṁ gatvā paśya vanasthalīm, chidyante saralās tatra kubjās tiṣṭhanti pādapāḥ
english_translation: Do not be excessively candid or simple-minded. Go and see the forest: the straight trees are cut down first, while crooked trees are left standing.
commentary_summary: Pragmatic discretion, strategic ambiguity, and self-protection prevent exploitation by adversaries.

sanskrit_text: मनसा चिन्तितं कार्यं वचसा न प्रकाशयेत्। मन्त्रेण रक्षयेद् गूढं कार्ये चापि नियोजयेत्॥
transliteration: manasā cintitaṁ kāryaṁ vacasā na prakāśayet, mantreṇa rakṣayed gūḍhaṁ kārye cāpi niyojayet
english_translation: Do not disclose what you have thought to do; by wise counsel keep it secret, and execute it into action without broadcast.
commentary_summary: Information security and operational secrecy ensure tactics cannot be pre-empted or compromised.
